title: Yummy Peppery Russian Berries Salad
description: A comforting, peppery Russian-inspired salad featuring tender boiled potatoes, eggs, cucumber, crumbled feta, and sweet frozen mixed berries for a quick sugar-free boost.
instructions: Boil diced potatoes in salted water for 10 minutes until tender then drain and cool to room temperature.
Simultaneously boil eggs for 9 minutes, then cool in ice water, peel, and quarter them.
Thaw frozen mixed berries by leaving them at room temperature for 10 minutes; drain excess liquid.
In a large bowl, combine diced potatoes, quartered eggs, diced cucumber, and thawed berries.
Add chopped dill, crumbled feta, and walnuts to the bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper until combined.
Pour the dressing over the salad and gently toss to coat all ingredients evenly.
Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more salt or pepper if desired.
Chill the salad for 15 minutes before serving to let flavors meld.
